entries.title: Evil Genius

primary.why: Evil Genius is a Windows-only lair-building strategy/simulation classic from Elixir Studios, now published digitally by Rebellion. The release date is September 28, 2004, with a current Windows PC storefront route. No console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so Windows PC is the archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC digital release, applying compatibility settings if needed on modern Windows. Treat Evil Genius 2 as a separate sequel.
